jobs_results.title: Hiring Drupal Frontend Developer (Bengaluru)
jobs_results.description:
We're looking for a Drupal Frontend Developer with strong front-end engineering skills and solid working knowledge of Drupal to build high-quality, accessible, and performant user experiences. This is a frontend-heavy role (~70% frontend / 30% backend)  you'll spend most of your time building responsive UI, custom themes, and reusable components, while working comfortably within Drupal's backend architecture to integrate and support your front-end work.

Key Responsibilities

Frontend (Primary Focus)

- Build responsive, pixel-perfect user interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+)
- Develop and maintain custom Drupal themes using Twig
- Build reusable, component-based UI using Single Directory Components (SDC) or similar component-driven approaches
- Convert Figma/design mockups into accessible, cross-browser-compatible interfaces (WCAG compliance)
- Optimize front-end performance (page load times, Core Web Vitals, asset/bundle optimization)

Backend (Supporting Focus)

- Develop and maintain custom Drupal modules to support front-end functionality
- Work on site building, configuration management, and content architecture (content types, Views)
- Integrate with RESTful APIs and JSON:API for front-end data consumption
- Troubleshoot, debug, and support Drupal upgrades
- Use Composer and Drush for dependency management and site operations

General

- Participate in code reviews and follow Git-based collaborative workflows (branching, PRs)
- Collaborate closely with designers, backend developers, and project managers to deliver projects on time

Required Skills & Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in Drupal (9/10/11) development, with a strong front-end focus
- Strong hands-on JavaScript (ES6+)  not just jQuery-level scripting
- Genuine, applied experience with React or Vue.Js  not certification-only knowledge
- Solid Twig theming and custom theme development from scratch
- Solid HTML5, CSS3 (SASS/SCSS a plus), responsive design, and accessibility (WCAG) skills
- Working knowledge of Drupal site building (content types, Views, configuration management)
- Basic-to-solid PHP understanding  enough to work with Drupal APIs and REST/JSON:API endpoints
- Familiarity with Composer, Drush, and Git-based workflows
- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail

Nice to Have

- Hands-on experience with Single Directory Components (SDC)
- Experience with decoupled/headless Drupal (React/Vue/Next.Js front-end on a Drupal backend)
- Exposure to CI/CD processes and tools
- Component library experience (Storybook, PatternLab, or similar)
- Front-end performance optimization expertise (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, bundle size) .

jobs_results.description:
Job Title :  Frontend Developer (.NET | React/Angular | AWS)

Experience :  4+ Years

Location :  Bangalore (Onsite)

Shift Timing :  12 : 00 PM to 9 AM

Job Summary : 

We are looking for an experienced Frontend Developer with strong full-stack development capabilities to join our team in Bangalore. The ideal candidate should have expertise in modern frontend frameworks such as React or Angular, along with hands-on experience in C#/.NET, AWS Cloud Services, and PostgreSQL. You will be responsible for building scalable, high-performance web applications while collaborating with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment.

Key Responsibilities : 

- Develop high-quality, scalable, and maintainable frontend and backend applications based on business requirements.

- Design, develop, and maintain responsive user interfaces using React or Angular.

- Build and maintain RESTful APIs using C#/.NET technologies.

- Develop cloud-native applications using AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, AppSync, SNS, and related services.

- Design, write, and optimize SQL queries and stored procedures using PostgreSQL.

- Perform unit testing, integration testing, and end-to-end testing to ensure application quality.

- Deploy software updates and coordinate with DevOps teams for smooth releases.

- Monitor application performance and optimize systems for scalability and reliability.

- Troubleshoot, identify, and resolve production issues promptly.

- Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and design discussions.

- Collaborate with Product, QA, Infrastructure, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality software solutions.

- Maintain technical documentation including APIs, architecture, database schemas, and troubleshooting guides.

- Leverage AI-powered development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to improve development productivity.

- Implement best practices for code quality, testing, and continuous improvement.

Required Technical Skills : 

- 4+ years of hands-on experience in frontend development using React and/or Angular.

- Strong experience in C#/.NET development and object-oriented programming.

- Experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs.

- Solid knowledge of PostgreSQL, SQL optimization, and relational database concepts.

- Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services including EC2, Lambda, S3, AppSync, SNS, and related technologies.

- Familiarity with GitHub, GitLab, and version control best practices.

- Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

Qualifications : 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, onsite development environment.

Preferred Skills : 

- Experience building cloud-native and microservices-based applications.

- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

- Exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code.

- Experience with automated testing frameworks and software quality best practices.

If you are passionate about building modern, scalable applications using the latest technologies and enjoy working in a collaborative Agile environment, we'd love to hear from you.
